name: When is a flexible commission structure a good option for selling a home?

mainEntity.name: When is a flexible commission structure a good option for selling a home?

acceptedAnswer.text: A flexible commission structure can be a good option for homeowners who have some experience in real estate transactions, are comfortable taking on certain aspects of the selling process, or have a specific marketing strategy in mind. It's particularly beneficial if you want to retain more equity from your home sale, especially in competitive markets in areas like Miami-Dade or Broward County. Consider this option if you're prepared to be actively involved in certain stages of the sale.
acceptedAnswer.description: A flexible commission structure suits sellers with real estate experience or those willing to be more involved in the selling process to potentially save on commission.
